notes.title: Are you enjoying Fighting Games Fest this week?
notes.content:
This week, Steam is celebrating the Fighting Games Fest! There are so many amazing games participating in the event, including our very own Serpent Showdown!

Some of the other indies we have already enjoyed from this event include:

 Fight of Animals A hilarious game where you can fight a "magic squirrel" with your "power hook dog"

 Tough Love Arena With bright, expressive characters, there's loads of fun in this tiny indie fighting game

 Cake Bash You play as cake as you you fight up to 3 other cakes

 Bird Boxing BIRDS. BOXING. Need we say more?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1615560/Serpent_Showdown/

In the spirit of the event, we've discounted Serpent Showdown -15% through July 22nd, so grab a copy if you haven't already, don your cardboard armor and sharpen your crayon-swords for some 1v1 snekky madness!
